# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Imports
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

import gtk, gobject  # @UnresolvedImport

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Code
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _main_quit(*args, **kwargs):
    gtk.main_quit()
    return False


def create_inputhook_gtk(stdin_file):
    def inputhook_gtk():
        gobject.io_add_watch(stdin_file, gobject.IO_IN, _main_quit)
        gtk.main()
        return 0

    return inputhook_gtk
